sets.name: Line
sets.note: Built from strokes. Lighter on the page, and the register most software brands sit in.

sets.name: Mass
sets.note: Built from solid form and negative space. Survives being shrunk, embossed, or printed in one colour.

tally.title: Tally
tally.idea: A count kept in the open. The one thing the product sells is that its numbers are real.

margin.title: Margin
margin.idea: Where the money actually splits: most to the member, the rest keeps the company running.

confirm.title: Confirm
confirm.idea: Payment releases on the network's callback, not on a progress bar. The long arm carries past the tick.

statement.title: Statement
statement.idea: Two lines of record and a total, right-aligned the way a ledger closes.

monogram.title: Monogram
monogram.idea: An R with the leg carried out in the accent. Survives being stamped on anything.

reconcile.title: Reconcile
reconcile.idea: Two records laid over each other until they agree — what the treasury dashboard does every day.

tile.title: Tile (current)
tile.idea: The prototype's mark, unchanged. Here so the others are judged against something.

notch.title: Notch
notch.idea: The cut we take, taken out of the mark itself. Negative space does the work, so it holds at any size.

stack.title: Stack
stack.idea: Payouts landing, widest at the bottom. Reads as accumulation rather than as a chart.

aperture.title: Aperture
aperture.idea: One disc, one wedge, drawn at the size the margin actually is. Widened until the accent still exists at 19px.

slot.title: Slot
slot.idea: A ledger cut into the tile. The last line is the total, and it is the one that carries the colour.

half.title: Half
half.idea: A coin cut on a chord rather than through the centre. Simple to stamp — but see the note below.

pill.title: Pill
pill.idea: The same tile, cut through. Two halves that only mean anything together.

flow.title: Flow
flow.idea: Outside money in, your money out — §2's first and last arrow. See the note below.
